meta_title: fluxer.fans · a fan club with actual fans
meta_description: An unofficial, fan-made corner of the internet for people who like Fluxer, the open source chat app. There are also fans. The spinning kind.
strip_text: Unofficial fan project. Not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by Fluxer Platform AB.
hero_lead: A homemade, slightly windy corner of the internet for people who like Fluxer, the open source chat app. Turn up the fan, poke the little fans, and send a cheer into the night.
tap_hint: Tap any little fan in the scene to hear from it.
composer_note: Cheers aren't saved or sent anywhere. The fan just blows them away.
composer_empty: Type something first. The fan can't blow away nothing.
composer_sent: Whoosh. Your cheer is off into the night sky.
composer_sent_calm: The fan is off, so your cheer floats up slowly. Very peaceful.
scene_label: 3D scene: a cozy floating island at night. A big desk fan with a smiley face blows wind at a small crowd of chat-bubble creatures holding foam fingers, pennants and tiny hand fans.
scene_error_body: Your browser couldn't load the 3D scene (WebGL might be turned off). Everything else on the page still works.
cheer_4: Is it windy or is it me?
cheer_9: I'm a fan of the fan.
def_1: A person who really, really likes something.
def_1_example: They're a huge fan of Fluxer and tell everyone in the group chat.
def_2: A machine with spinning blades that pushes air around.
def_2_example: Put the fan on 3, it's getting warm in this voice call.
def_outro: This site is about both. Usually at the same time.
about_lead: Fluxer is a free and open source chat app for friends, groups and communities. It's the thing we're fans of. It isn't ours, we just like it a lot.
about_chat: Talk one on one, in group chats or in community channels, with Markdown, files and your own emoji and stickers.
about_voice: Hop into a voice channel to talk, share your screen or turn on your camera.
about_source: The code is open source under the AGPLv3, so anyone can read it, change it and share it.
about_selfhost: Use it on fluxer.app, or run it on your own server and keep your community's data there.
about_indie: Made by an independent company in Sweden, funded by Plutonium subscribers and donors instead of venture capital.
about_footnote: Facts taken from fluxer.app. If anything here is out of date, the official site wins.
fine_body: fluxer.fans is an unofficial, fan-made project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by or connected to Fluxer Platform AB or the Fluxer platform. The Fluxer name is only used to say which app we're fans of. For the real thing, your account and support, go to fluxer.app.
fine_privacy: No accounts, no analytics, no tracking. The only cookie remembers your language, and anything you type into the cheer box stays in your browser until the fan blows it away.
more_body: fluxer.fans isn't my only project. The rest live in my Fluxer community, so come say hi.
fine_built: Made by fans, with SvelteKit and Threlte.
